title: Remove the v1 refunds endpoint (PAY-158)
description: Deletes src/routes/refunds-v1.ts and the REFUNDS_V1_ENABLED flag. All callers moved to POST /v2/refunds. Implements ADR-009.

expected.summary: 2 pages flag. Refunds API guide (High: anchored file deleted). Payments API service overview (Medium: src/** glob on a deleted file plus removed identifier REFUNDS_V1_ENABLED).

pages.title: Refunds API guide
pages.why: Exact critical anchor src/routes/refunds-v1.ts was removed.

pages.title: Payments API service overview
pages.why: Glob src/** (normal) on a removed file scores 0.42; the page lists REFUNDS_V1_ENABLED, a removed identifier, so +0.3 gives 0.72. Glob anchors do not count as 'anchored file removed'.

mustNotFlag: ADR-009: Retire the v1 refunds API
expected.mustNotFlagWhy: The codebase tour (src/** glob) mentions no removed identifier. Local development setup anchors src/config.ts but the change there is 1 line and it does not mention REFUNDS_V1_ENABLED. ADR-009 is anchored to Jira only.
